title: Conflated Confusion Matrix with Invalid Denominators
root_cause: Phase 4D combined 4 heterogeneous perturbation tasks into single 5/11 matrix without proper task-specific denominators
remediation: Decoupled into 3 separate task-specific confusion matrices with valid integer denominators (Reference: N=5; Date: N=4; Structural: N=7 or N=8)
